articles.headline: Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot open to including Benjamin Netanyahu in coalition
articles.title: Eisenkot open to Netanyahu joining Israel’s next government
articles.summary: Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot, officially tasked by President Isaac Herzog to form Israel's next government, stated on Sunday in Jerusalem that he is open to including Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in his coalition. Eisenkot faces a six-week deadline to build a administration following inconclusive elections on October 27, 2026, where his four-party alliance secured 48 seats against 53 for Netanyahu's bloc, leaving both short of a parliamentary majority.
articles.description: Israel's president officially tasks the opposition leader with forming a new government.

articles.headline: Thick smog blankets Delhi as air quality reaches severe levels on Deepavali
articles.title: Thick smog blankets Delhi on Deepavali night, AQI at 20 stations ‘severe’
articles.summary: A smoky haze settled across Delhi on November 8, 2026, pushing air quality into the severe category at 20 monitoring stations as residents defied restrictions by bursting firecrackers past permissible hours. The city recorded an average Air Quality Index of 376, with Jahangirpuri reaching 460, while experts attributed the deteriorating conditions to fireworks, vehicular emissions, and stubble burning.
articles.description: The Air Quality Early Warning System (EWS) has forecast that Delhi's air quality is likely to slip into the 'severe' category from November 9 and remain there for the subsequent few days

articles.headline: Gadi Eisenkot warns of historic crisis while seeking to form Israeli government
articles.title: Eisenkot warns of Israel crisis as he seeks to replace Netanyahu’s government
articles.summary: Former military chief Gadi Eisenkot officially received a mandate on November 8, 2026, from President Isaac Herzog to form a new Israeli government, warning that veteran Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has pushed the nation into a severe diplomatic crisis. Eisenkot reached out to Netanyahu's allies for a national emergency administration, while navigating deep political polarization and a parliament where his bloc lacks an outright majority.
articles.description: isenkot, 66, a political novice who has vowed to bridge Israel's deep polarisation under Netanyahu, formally received a mandate from President Isaac Herzog, giving him 28 days to form a government despite his bloc lacking a clear majority

articles.summary: South Africa's ruling African National Congress faced its lowest point in popularity during local government elections held on November 4, 2026, securing roughly 30 percent of the vote amid widespread voter anger over failing public services like water and electricity. According to the Independent Electoral Commission, the historic party led by Nelson Mandela lost significant ground in major municipalities such as Johannesburg and Pretoria to opposition groups like the Democratic Alliance.
articles.description: The once-dominant ANC — the party of Nelson Mandela — had received around 30% of the vote in Wednesday's (November 4, 2026) local government elections with 99% of ballots counted

Egyptian authorities reported that the impact derailed the second train in the al-Ayyat district of Giza province. Emergency services deployed more than 70 ambulances to transport casualties to nearby hospitals following the incident.

articles.headline: U.S. military executes targeted airstrikes on Iran amid ongoing nuclear negotiations
articles.title: U.S. military carries out fresh targeted strikes on Iran as Tehran weighs mediator's proposals
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump confirmed that American forces conducted limited military strikes on an Iranian air defence system on November 6, 2026. The operation occurred as Qatari mediators advanced proposals for a bridge deal to address differences over Tehran's nuclear programme, though Iranian officials insisted on several core concessions before engaging in formal talks.

articles.title: Trump confirms new US strikes on Iran’s Qeshm Island
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump announced that American forces carried out minor strikes against Iranian air defence installations on Qeshm Island. Iranian state media reported explosions and the downing of a United States drone, while Qatari officials dismissed rumours that negotiations between Washington and Tehran had failed following recent midterm elections.

articles.headline: Clashes in northern South Sudan leave 23 dead and thousands displaced
articles.title: 23 dead in clashes between South Sudan government, opposition forces
articles.summary: Four weeks of fighting in northern South Sudan between government forces and opposition fighters from the Sudan People's Liberation Army-In Opposition (SPLA-IO) have resulted in 23 deaths and 17 injuries. According to authorities and police, over 100,000 people have fled the conflict zone. The violence occurs as the country prepares for its first national elections scheduled for December 22, amid heightened ethnic unrest and a history of civil conflict.
articles.description: Fighting in the Ruweng administrative area has left 23 dead and thousands displaced, officials said, as South Sudan heads towards elections on December 22

articles.headline: Six killed and fifteen injured in Krakow mass shooting
articles.title: What we know so far after Krakow gun attack
articles.summary: At least six people died and fifteen others sustained injuries after a gunman opened fire on random individuals in central Krakow's Main Market Square. Armed officers engaged the suspect, who was subsequently arrested at the scene. Polish authorities confirmed the attacker wore military-style attire, while Prime Minister Donald Tusk traveled to the city as investigations into the background and circumstances continue.
articles.description: Six people were killed in a random shooting in Krakow's main square, and three bodies were later found at the home of the attacker.

articles.headline: United States launches Task Force Iron Gate to curb Iranian weapons smuggling
articles.title: US task force to cut off Iran’s transport of advanced weapons: What we know
articles.summary: The United States Central Command (CENTCOM) announced the creation of Task Force Iron Gate, a unit designed to target land routes and the Caspian Sea to prevent Iran from transporting advanced weapons and sanctioned materials. Based in Tampa, Florida, the 20-person unit aims to reinforce maritime blockades. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps dismissed the plan as wordplay aimed at economic pressure, while analysts debate its diplomatic and regional implications.
articles.description: As fears of an escalation grow, Washington announces 'Task Force Iron Gate'.

articles.headline: France confirms European representation at upcoming United States-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi
articles.title: Europe will be represented at U.S.-mediated Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi: France
articles.summary: France announced that European representatives will participate in upcoming United States-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi scheduled for November 10 and November 11. French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot stated that France will ensure Europe's voice is heard during discussions aimed at ending the war in Ukraine. The announcement follows concerns over potential bilateral negotiations between Washington and Moscow regarding European security architecture.
articles.description: Although Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has made it clear that he wants involvement from European allies in the process, Russia has suggested there would be no place for European representatives at the table

articles.headline: Poland launches terrorism probe following Krakow shooting rampage that killed six
articles.title: Poland calls Krakow shooting rampage 'terrorist' attack
articles.summary: Poland initiated a terrorism investigation after a 24-year-old Polish man killed six people in a random shooting rampage in Krakow's Main Market Square. A British national was among the dead, and 15 others were wounded. Police later found the suspect's parents and sister dead at his home in Ostrowiec Swietokrzyski. The gunman was critically wounded in a shootout with police, prompting Poland to declare two days of national mourning.
articles.description: A British national was among the dead, according to police. Among the 15 wounded were nationals from Austria, Britain, Germany, Portugal and Russia, says an Interior Ministry spokeswoman

articles.headline: Iran executes three men for armed unrest during January anti-government protests
articles.title: Iran executes three men for 'armed unrest' after January protests
articles.summary: Iranian state media reported that Hassan Dioband, Hamid Kazemi and Reza Zanganeh were executed after being convicted of carrying out armed unrest, including throwing explosives and setting fire to public facilities in Karaj during anti-government protests in January 2026. articles.description: It is claimed Hassan Dioband, Hamid Kazemi and Reza Zanganeh were part of anti-government protests earlier this year.

articles.headline: Small migrant boat sinks off northwestern Senegal leaving at least 21 dead
articles.title: At least 21 dead as small boat sinks off Senegal
articles.summary: A small migrant boat capsized off the northwestern coast of Senegal, resulting in the deaths of at least 21 people. The Senegalese Interior Ministry stated that search operations remain ongoing after one survivor was rescued. The vessel sank near the Loumpoul dunes between Dakar and Saint-Louis. The incident highlights ongoing perilous migration attempts from West Africa toward Spain's Canary Islands, where authorities recently declared an emergency due to surging arrivals.
articles.description: Senegalese Interior Ministry says one person rescued as search operation continues after migrant vessel capsized.

articles.headline: Israel defense minister says military mission against Iran is not complete
articles.title: Israel Defence Minister says 'mission not complete' on Iran
articles.summary: Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz stated that military operations against Iran remain incomplete and warned Hezbollah against entering any renewed conflict. Speaking at a memorial event, Katz reiterated allegations that Tehran seeks nuclear weapons, while Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu faces domestic political pressure and electoral fallout following multi-front military campaigns in Gaza, Lebanon, and Syria.
articles.description: "Concerning Iran, the mission is still not complete. Iran is trying to renew its efforts to obtain nuclear weapons — alongside other grave efforts that place the State of Israel in real danger," says Mr. Katz

articles.headline: Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant loses external power and relies on backup generators
articles.title: Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant relying on generators again after losing external power supply
articles.summary: The Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant in southeastern Ukraine lost its external electricity supply after the Ferosplavna line disconnected, according to the International Atomic Energy Agency and plant management. Facility operators activated emergency diesel generators to maintain reactor cooling systems. The Russian-controlled installation currently possesses sufficient fuel reserves to operate these backup generators for approximately two weeks while investigations continue.
articles.description: Zaporizhzhia, which produces no electricity but needs power supplied by two external links to keep nuclear fuel ‌cool, lost its off-site electricity supply after the Ferosplavna power line disconnected, the IAEA said

articles.headline: Poland begins national mourning following fatal mass shooting in Krakow
articles.title: Poland mourns six killed in attack as authorities launch ‘terrorism’ probe
articles.summary: Poland initiated two days of national mourning after a twenty-four-year-old armed suspect killed six people in central Krakow. The national prosecutor's office opened a terrorism investigation into the shooting, while three additional bodies were found at the suspect's residence. Interior Minister Marcin Kierwinski stated that the attacker was influenced by far-right ideologies following the tragic events.
articles.description: 'Terrorism' investigation launched after government officials say suspect likely influenced by far-right ideology.

articles.headline: Democratic candidates flip five state attorney general offices in midterm elections
articles.title: Democratic wins in State AG races give Trump a new headache
articles.summary: Democratic candidates flipped attorney general offices in Texas, Ohio, Georgia, Iowa and Kansas during the midterm elections, challenging conservative legal strategies. articles.description: Incoming Democratic attorneys general could halt ⁠cooperation with federal immigration operations, fortify abortion access and file multistate challenges against the Trump administration's environmental and gun policies

articles.headline: Russian overnight strikes leave hundreds of thousands without electricity in Ukraine
articles.title: Russian strikes on Ukraine leave hundreds of thousands without electricity
articles.summary: A Russian overnight attack on an energy facility in the Dnipropetrovsk region left more than 600,000 people without electricity, according to Ukrainian energy provider DTEK. An additional 250,000 residents lost power in the Kharkiv region following a separate infrastructure strike. Ukrainian officials stated that repair efforts were being hampered by repeated attacks as the country faces another harsh winter of war.
articles.description: About 850,000 people lose power after Russian attacks on energy infrastructure in Ukraine's Dnipropetrovsk and Kharkiv.

articles.title: Three tankers caught fire in Strait of Hormuz: Iran

articles.description: The Guards did not specify the names or nationality of the tankers

articles.title: New Zealanders won’t know for weeks who won election as neither side secures clear victory

articles.headline: Drone attack on military base in northern Colombia kills three soldiers
articles.title: Drone attack on Colombian army base kills three soldiers and wounds 16

articles.headline: Twenty five killed in Saudi airstrikes in Yemen

articles.title: Paraguay's ousted President charged with crimes linked to collapse of major bank

articles.description: Republicans can stick with Trumpism or chart a new path, writes BBC Washington correspondent Daniel Bush.

articles.headline: New Zealand voters reject major political parties amid a deepening economic crisis
articles.title: 'Flat', 'tired', 'cynical': Unusually gloomy Kiwis deliver New Zealand's tightest election in years

Citizens face soaring living costs, high unemployment, and severe healthcare strains, driving a massive exodus of residents abroad while minor political parties made unprecedented electoral gains.
articles.description: The national mood is low, and faith in politics even lower - with voters deserting the major parties at the polls.

articles.headline: Police clash with protesters as anti-government rallies sweep France
articles.title: Police clash with protesters as anti-government rallies sweep France
articles.description: Police have clashed with protesters in Paris as Yellow Vests defied a ban on their rally, leading to arrests.

articles.headline: Chess player Anuj Shrivatri becomes India's one hundredth grandmaster in the Philippines
articles.title: It’s really great to see hard work pay off, says Anuj Shrivatri on becoming India’s 100th GM
articles.summary: Twenty-two-year-old Anuj Shrivatri achieved the grandmaster title after winning the seventh ASEAN open individual championship in the Philippines. The player from Madhya Pradesh stated that he maintained focus on decision-making rather than results during the final rounds of the tournament. Following this milestone, Shrivatri aims to surpass a 2600 rating and secure victories in multiple upcoming international chess competitions.
articles.description: Shrivatri said becoming a GM was his main aim and now that he had achieved it, the focus is to “cross 2600 rating barrier

articles.headline: India records twenty-eight percent decline in oilmeal exports during the April-August period
articles.title: India’s April-August oilmeal exports fall 28.5% as soymeal loses to Brazil, Argentina
articles.summary: India's outbound shipments of oilmeals dropped to twelve lakh tonnes during the first five months of the financial year due to a significant decrease in soybean meal sales. The Solvent Extractors Association of India stated that Indian soybean meal struggled with pricing pressure against competitors from Argentina and Brazil. Strong domestic demand and elevated maritime freight costs further constrained export volumes across key Asian markets.
articles.description: Soybean meal shipments plunged 73% as cheaper supplies from Argentina and Brazil captured market share, the Solvent Extractors’ Association of India said

articles.headline: Defence minister Rajnath Singh calls for highest military preparedness at Bagdogra Air Force station
articles.title: Rajnath Singh warns of evolving threats, calls for highest military readiness
articles.summary: Indian Defence Minister Rajnath Singh urged armed forces personnel at the Bagdogra Air Force station in West Bengal to maintain high operational readiness amid an increasingly complex security landscape. Speaking near the frontier with China, Singh highlighted emerging threats including cyber attacks, proxy wars, and misinformation campaigns, while reaffirming the government's push for indigenous defence technologies through start-ups.
articles.description: Addressing personnel at key airbase near China frontier, Defence Minister warns of adversaries exploiting ‘vulnerabilities’; he also reviews Army’s LAC infrastructure, operational preparedness and lauds initiatives aimed at strengthening ties with local communities

articles.headline: President Donald Trump states he was joking about offering Dana White press secretary role
articles.title: Trump says he was 'kidding' about Dana White press secretary offer
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump clarified that his social media post offering the White House press secretary position to Ultimate Fighting Championship chief executive Dana White was intended as a joke. The clarification followed a social media announcement where Trump stated White had been offered the job and urged him to accept it. The press secretary position has remained vacant since October following the departure of Katie Zacharia.
articles.description: The president told the Ultimate Fighting Championship boss to "please take the job" in a Truth Social post on Saturday.

articles.headline: Stubble burning worsens severe air pollution across the Indo-Gangetic Plain
articles.title: How governmentality exacerbates the problem of farmers’ stubble burning
articles.summary: Every November, the Indo-Gangetic Plain suffers from heavy pollution as monsoon winds cease and temperature drops trap vehicular and industrial emissions beneath an inversion layer. According to research published in April 2025 by S. R. Jagadale and J. M. Shaikh, farmers in Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, and Uttar Pradesh worsen this toxic haze by burning rice chaff to prepare fields for Rabi wheat, representing the cheapest clearance method.
articles.description: A new study by researchers Sujit Raghunathrao Jagadale and Javed M. Shaikh at the Indian Institute of Management, Amritsar analyses the problem of stubble burning from the lens of ‘governmentality’ and market failure

articles.headline: Keralam public health experts urge epidemiological review amid measles outbreaks
articles.title: Keralam measles outbreaks call for a relook at disease epidemiology
articles.summary: Public health experts in Keralam are calling for a reassessment of disease epidemiology as measles outbreaks affect districts including Kozhikode, Malappuram, and Palakkad with 824 confirmed cases. The Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme reported five deaths, while research highlights infections crossing age groups, breakthrough cases in vaccinated children, and waning maternal antibodies affecting infants.
articles.description: Once predominantly a childhood disease affecting children aged one to five, measles is now being reported across age groups, including among fully vaccinated individuals and infants below nine months, who are not yet eligible for routine measles vaccination

articles.headline: Punjab records record single-day surge in farm fires during Deepavali
articles.title: At 1,152, Punjab records season’s biggest single-day jump in farm fires on Deepavali
articles.summary: Punjab recorded 1,152 farm fires on Deepavali, pushing the seasonal total to 4,459 by November 8, 2026, according to official data. Tarn Taran led with 654 cases. Despite advisories and ₹62 lakh in environmental fines, enforcement agencies registered 884 FIRs under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and marked 1,017 red entries. The Commission for Air Quality Management subsequently urged bureaucrats to intensify monitoring and hold nodal officers accountable.
articles.description: The latest figures indicate a significant rise in crop residue burning despite government advisories, enforcement measures and monetary penalties aimed at discouraging the practice

articles.headline: Trump concedes deportation policy may have alienated voters in midterms
articles.title: Trump says his immigration policy ‘too tough’ for voters
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump acknowledged that his deportation policy may have been too extreme for voters, contributing to his party losing control of the House of Representatives and Senate. Speaking on CBS on November 8, Trump suggested working with the Democratic-controlled Congress on a moderate immigration agreement while appointing hardliner Stephen Miller as White House chief of staff, amid protests over enforcement operations.
articles.description: Trump concedes some voters were unhappy with his administration's controversial deportation drive.

articles.headline: Thousands of demonstrators protest across France against rising cost of living
articles.title: More than 140,000 rally as new protests against rising costs sweep France
articles.summary: Tens of thousands of protesters rallied across France for a fourth consecutive weekend to demonstrate against the rising cost of living. The Ministry of the Interior reported 146,000 participants nationwide, while unions estimated 250,000 demonstrators. The protests involved heavy security deployments, clashes in Paris and Lyon, and occurred ahead of the presidential election scheduled for April.
articles.description: Tear gas fired in Paris and Lyon as interior minister warns authorities are 'ready and waiting' for rioters and looters.

articles.headline: Tamil Nadu faces water crisis and lower rice production risks
articles.title: T.N. may be heading towards a water crisis, unless northeast monsoon comes to the rescue
articles.summary: Tamil Nadu faces a potential water crisis and lower rice production as major irrigation reservoir storage sits at one-third of combined capacity. The State government demanded Karnataka release 20.7 tmcft during meetings with the Cauvery Water Management Authority. However, the authority ratified a recommendation for Karnataka to release only 3.88 tmcft over 15 days starting November 7, 2026.
articles.description: As of now, the aggregate storage in the major 15 irrigation reservoirs is about a third of the combined capacity of the reservoirs. In the corresponding period last year, the combined storage was around 92%

articles.headline: Ukraine’s Zaporizhzhia faces threat as Russian drones close in
articles.title: Ukraine’s Zaporizhzhia faces threat as Russian drones close in
articles.description: Ukraine’s Zaporizhzhia, once a refuge for those fleeing the war, is now facing growing danger.

articles.headline: Foreign portfolio investors return to Indian equities with strong inflows
articles.title: Early November trend indicates return of FPIs into Indian equities
articles.summary: Foreign institutional investors purchased a net ₹45,960 crore of Indian shares during the five trading sessions ending November 6, 2026, signaling a potential return of foreign portfolio investors after September withdrawals. Provisional exchange data showed this recovery coincided with an 8.58% rise in the Nifty 50. Analysts attribute the shift to domestic economic resilience and long-term growth prospects, though global volatility and external macroeconomic headwinds remain.
articles.description: Provisional exchange data show that foreign institutional investors purchased Indian shares worth a net ₹45,960 crore during the five trading sessions ended on November 6, 2026

articles.headline: Marco Bezzecchi wins Qatar Grand Prix as Marc Marquez awaits title
articles.title: MotoGP: Bezzecchi denies Marquez world title as motorsport returns to Qatar
articles.summary: Marc Marquez delayed his eighth MotoGP title bid after finishing behind Marco Bezzecchi at the Qatar Grand Prix in Lusail on November 8. Pole-sitter Bezzecchi secured his sixth win of the season, cutting his deficit to 74 points. Meanwhile, Jorge Martin finished seventh to keep his championship hopes alive despite trailing by 60 points, as motorsport returned to the region following the war on Iran.
articles.description: Aprilia's Marco Bezzecchi wins Qatar Grand Prix as Ducati's Marc Marquez finishes second.

articles.headline: West Bengal chief minister defends police encounter killing in Raiganj
articles.title: CM Suvendu defends encounter in Raiganj, says police entitled to retaliate in self-defence
articles.summary: West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari defended the fatal police shooting of a rape-murder accused during an exchange of fire in Raiganj on November 9, 2026. Speaking in Digha, he stated that officers possess operational freedom and self-defence rights regarding serious crimes. The incident marks the fourth police encounter death in the state since May.
articles.description: The CM’s comments came hours after a man accused of raping and murdering his 13-year-old niece in Raiganj was killed in an exchange of fire with police

articles.headline: Rape and murder accused Dilip Roy killed by police in Raiganj encounter
articles.title: Another ‘encounter’ in West Bengal: Rape-murder accused killed in Raiganj
articles.summary: Dilip Roy, a prime suspect in the rape and murder of a thirteen-year-old minor, was shot dead by police during an exchange of gunfire while attempting to flee toward Bihar on November 9, 2026. According to police officials, the incident occurred at around 3:30 a.m. in the Gauri village area after officers located him following the discovery of the victim's mutilated body on November 5.
articles.description: This is the fourth such incident in the State since the BJP came to power. Earlier, two rape suspects in Gaighata and Baruipur and a murder suspect in Dhulian were shot dead by police

articles.headline: Tech executive Alice Huang accused of espionage targeting Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
articles.title: Who is Alice Huang, Chinese executive accused of spying on Nvidia CEO?
articles.summary: Chinese executive Alice Huang was accused by media reports of spying for Beijing during a relationship with Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang. According to the New York Times, US officials concluded she targeted the Nvidia boss while serving as a top executive at Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed International, which has faced investigations regarding chip exports.
articles.description: Public details are sparse about the woman, also known as Huang Le, who had reportedly been a top figure at a Singapore-based data centre company called Megaspeed International

articles.headline: Revised maximum retail prices for anti-cancer drugs take effect
articles.title: Revised MRPs of 1,364 anti-cancer formulations come into effect; consumers to save ₹3,540 crore/year
articles.summary: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority implemented revised maximum retail prices for 1,364 anti-cancer formulations on November 9, 2026. According to the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers, eighty-five pharmaceutical companies reported reductions exceeding 50 percent for 679 brands. The initiative aims to save consumers approximately 3,540 crore rupees annually.
articles.description: According to the Ministry, 85 pharmaceutical companies have reported revised MRPs for 1,364 anti-cancer formulations across 121 drugs as of November 8, 2026

articles.headline: Andhra Pradesh plans major restructuring of postgraduate education in universities
articles.title: Andhra Pradesh plans major overhaul of postgraduate education across 28 universities | Explained
articles.summary: The Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education proposed a comprehensive overhaul of postgraduate education across 28 state universities. The reforms aim to transform traditional institutions into specialised regional knowledge hubs. This restructuring focuses heavily on enhancing student employability, research capabilities, entrepreneurship, and regional economic development across the state.
articles.description: Proposed reforms seek to move beyond conventional, examination-orientated degrees towards interdisciplinary learning, industry exposure, research and emerging technologies

articles.headline: United States President Donald Trump orders Department of Justice to investigate Democrats
articles.title: Trump orders DOJ to investigate Democrats for ‘threatening’ people
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump directed the Department of Justice to investigate Democratic lawmakers for alleged threats following their midterm election victory. Writing on social media, Trump claimed without evidence that Democratic probes into his administration and associates amounted to criminal extortion. Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress in the November elections, granting them investigative powers.
articles.description: Trump lashed out at Democrats on Truth Social days after the party won control of Congress.

articles.headline: Krakow shooting suspect dies in hospital after attack
articles.title: Krakow shooting suspect has died in hospital, police say
articles.summary: A 24-year-old gunman suspected of killing six people in central Krakow died in hospital early Monday following a shootout with armed police. Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk described the attack as terrorism and announced two days of national mourning, while investigators indicated the suspect was inspired by far-right ideologies and had previously killed three family members.
articles.description: At least six people were killed in the shooting, and three bodies of the suspect's family members were found at their home.

articles.headline: Polish police confirm death of Krakow shooting spree suspect in hospital
articles.title: Krakow shooting suspect dies: Poland police
articles.summary: Regional police in Poland announced on November 9, 2026, that the 24-year-old man accused of killing six people during a weekend shooting in central Krakow died in hospital. The suspect had been in critical condition after sustaining wounds in a shootout with police following the attack that occurred on November 7, 2026.
articles.description: The gunman was wounded in a shootout with police and had been in critical condition in hospital

articles.headline: What do we know about Nvidia CEO’s affair with a suspected Chinese spy?
articles.title: What do we know about Nvidia CEO’s affair with a suspected Chinese spy?
articles.description: Adoration for the US tech giant’s CEO Jensen Huang has been labelled “Jensanity”, but can his reputation survive the news of his affair?

articles.headline: Yemeni government forces report battlefield advances as deadly strikes hit Sanaa
articles.title: Yemeni gov’t forces report advances as Houthis say deadly strikes hit Sanaa
articles.summary: Yemeni government forces reported repelling Houthi assaults and advancing in Marib and al-Jawf provinces during ongoing military operations. Meanwhile, the Houthi-run Saba news agency reported that air strikes killed at least 27 people and wounded about 30 others in al-Shariya village in Sanaa province. The Houthis blamed the Saudi-led coalition, while Al Jazeera could not independently verify the competing claims.
articles.description: Civilians bear the brunt of fighting as 27 people reported killed in strikes on a village in Sanaa province.

articles.headline: Greek coast guard recovers bodies of dead migrants off Crete
articles.title: Greece recovers 12 dead migrants from boat off of Crete, Coast Guard says
articles.summary: The Greek coast guard recovered twelve dead migrants from a boat south of Crete on November 9, 2026, alongside eight other bodies found in a separate vessel. Maritime authorities rescued roughly forty survivors during emergency operations launched amid strong winds. Crete has increasingly become a primary entry point into the European Union for migrants departing from Libya.
articles.description: The coast guard rescued ‌another 18 people from ‌the ⁠boat about 15 nautical ⁠miles off the port of Kaloi Limenes and dozens of others in ​two other ‌incidents off Crete, says a coast guard official

articles.headline: Krakow mass shooting suspect dies in hospital following arrest
articles.title: Poland mass shooting assailant dies in hospital, police say
articles.summary: The 24-year-old Polish man who killed six people in Krakow died in hospital on November 9, 2026. Police previously shot and arrested the gunman following the attack at the historic main square. Investigators subsequently discovered his family dead at home, while prosecutors launched an investigation into the incident as an act of terrorism.
articles.description: Suspect shot by police and arrested minutes ‌after gunfire opened on people in central Krakow.

articles.headline: Congress criticises Modi government over air pollution mortality rates in India
articles.title: Congress slams Modi govt. for being in ‘denial’ on impact of air pollution on mortality
articles.summary: Congress general secretary Jairam Ramesh criticised the administration on November 9, 2026, for denying that air pollution causes high mortality, citing a FICCI-EY report attributing around two million deaths to pollution in 2023. Ramesh urged tightening PM2.5 and ozone standards and revamping the National Clean Air Programme. The remarks came as Delhi experienced severe air quality with an AQI of 370.
articles.description: Jairam Ramesh cited the FICCI-EY report and pointed out that it categorically states that around 2 million deaths (about 22% of total) were attributable to air pollution in India in 2023

articles.headline: Palestinians mark anniversary of Berlin Wall fall alongside West Bank barrier protests
articles.title: How Israel’s separation wall compares with the Berlin Wall
articles.summary: Palestinians marked the anniversary of the Berlin Wall fall on November 9, 2026, protesting Israel's separation wall in the occupied West Bank. Built starting in 2002 and declared illegal by the International Court of Justice in 2004, the barrier cuts through Palestinian territory, isolating communities and agricultural land while operating alongside hundreds of military checkpoints and roadblocks.
articles.description: How Israel's wall, checkpoints and permits divide Palestinians in the occupied West Bank and cut farmers off from land.

articles.headline: McLaren driver Lando Norris wins Sao Paulo Grand Prix as Mercedes claims title
articles.title: Sao Paulo GP: McLaren's Lando Norris wins as Mercedes seals Constructors' title
articles.summary: McLaren driver Lando Norris won the rainy Sao Paulo Grand Prix at Interlagos on November 8, 2026, leading 47 of 71 laps ahead of Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar. Meanwhile, Mercedes secured its first Formula 1 constructors' title since 2021, despite Kimi Antonelli finishing fifth. Norris celebrated his third season victory after starting from pole position.
articles.description: Lewis Hamilton became the second F1 driver with 400 starts after Fernando Alonso; Brazil’s home drivers have a disappointing race

articles.headline: Modernist artist Arpita Singh passes away at 89
articles.title: Modernist artist Arpita Singh, aged 89, passes away
articles.summary: Modernist artist Arpita Singh died at Fortis Hospital in New Delhi from age-related ailments on November 9, 2026, at the age of 89, according to her husband Paramjit Singh. Known for her figurative works exploring social upheaval, she received the Padma Bhushan in 2011. Her cremation is scheduled for November 15, 2026, at Lodhi Crematorium, leaving behind a legacy celebrated by cultural figures.
articles.description: Arpita Singh received the Padma Bhushan in 2011 and the Lalit Kala Akademi Fellowship in 2014 for her contribution to the world of art

articles.headline: Parliament Monsoon session remains unprorogued for record 88 days
articles.title: Parliament’s Monsoon session remains unprorogued for record 88 days
articles.summary: The Indian Parliament's Monsoon session remained unprorogued for 88 days as of Monday, breaking a 2008 record. Both Houses were adjourned indefinitely on August 13. The government's decision leaves open the possibility of a short-notice sitting to consider a constitutional amendment for the Women's Reservation Bill, which requires a minimum notice of two days.
articles.description: As of November 9, 2026 morning, neither the Lok Sabha nor the Rajya Sabha had been formally prorogued, keeping open the possibility of convening an extended sitting of the existing session

articles.headline: Lando Norris wins Sao Paulo Grand Prix as Mercedes secure constructors title
articles.title: Lando Norris wins Sao Palo Grand Prix, but Mercedes seal constructors title
articles.summary: McLaren driver Lando Norris won the wet Sao Paulo Grand Prix from pole position on November 9, 2026, while Mercedes secured their ninth Formula One constructors world championship. Red Bull driver Max Verstappen finished second on a treacherous track, and Kimi Antonelli placed fifth with the fastest lap. Team boss Toto Wolff expressed pride in the organization following the wet race.
articles.description: Norris wins from pole position on a rainy Sao Paulo track as Mercedes win team title for the first time since 2021.

articles.headline: US offers twenty million dollars for Iran nuclear details
articles.title: US offers $20m reward for information about Iran's nuclear programme
articles.summary: The United States State Department announced a reward of up to twenty million dollars for information regarding Iran's nuclear programme, including facilities, equipment, and associated personnel. Meanwhile, United States Central Command established Task Force Iron Gate to restrict weapons movement and sanctioned material across Iranian borders, while regional mediators continued efforts to negotiate an end to the ongoing conflict.
articles.description: Donald Trump has repeatedly raised the prospect of renewing strikes against Iran's nuclear facilities.

articles.headline: Nvidia board launches probe into Jensen Huang over affair with suspected spy
articles.title: Jensen Huang: Silicon Valley superstar engulfed by personal scandal
articles.summary: Nvidia board of directors has initiated an investigation into Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang following reports he had a romantic relationship with a woman believed by United States intelligence to be a Chinese spy. The 63-year-old billionaire co-founded the artificial intelligence chip giant in 1993, which has grown into one of the world's most valuable companies. The board maintains confidence in his leadership.
articles.description: Once lauded as the "Taylor Swift of tech", Huang is mired in scandal after an affair with a suspected Chinese spy.

articles.headline: Six people killed in Muzaffarnagar car fire after collision with pole
articles.title: Car catches fire after hitting electric pole in U.P.'s Muzaffarnagar, six dead
articles.summary: Six individuals died when their car collided with an electric pole and caught fire along the Shamli highway in Uttar Pradesh's Muzaffarnagar district on November 9, 2026, according to police. Emergency responders transported the victims to the district hospital, where medical staff pronounced them dead. The occupants were travelling from Hisar in Haryana to Haridwar when the fatal accident occurred.
articles.description: The deceased have not yet been identified, and efforts are underway to establish their identities and inform their families

articles.headline: Maharashtra relaxes borewell restrictions until December 15 to combat drought
articles.title: Maharashtra relaxes borewell restrictions till December 15 to help farmers save trees amid drought
articles.summary: Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis announced a temporary relaxation of restrictions on drilling new borewells and deepening existing ones until December 15, 2026, to help farmers save trees during severe drought conditions. The measure requires prior authorization and is not universally applicable. Fadnavis made the announcement during a village interaction in Nagpur district following an 18.8 percent statewide rain deficit.
articles.description: The announcement came during an interaction with village sarpanches and local representatives at Lohari Sawanga in Nagpur district’s Narkhed taluka, where the Chief Minister had stayed overnight on November 7 to celebrate Deepavali with a farmer’s family

articles.headline: Six family members killed in Madhya Pradesh building fire
articles.title: Fire at building in Madhya Pradesh’s Katni on Deepavali night; six of family killed
articles.summary: A devastating fire broke out at a crockery shop inside a three-storey building in Barhi town of Madhya Pradesh on November 9, 2026, resulting in the deaths of six family members. According to Katni Collector Ashish Tiwari, the blaze started around midnight and overwhelmed the structure due to highly flammable materials stored on the lower floor.
articles.description: The incident occurred around midnight on Monday, November 9, in Barhi town; the fire could not be brought under control, partly because the crockery materials stored on the lower floor were highly flammable, said Katni Collector Ashish Tiwari

articles.headline: Houthis report 25 killed in Yemen strikes
articles.title: Houthis report 25 killed in Yemen strikes
articles.description: Yemen’s Houthis say at least 25 people have been killed and 30 injured in air strikes.

articles.headline: Pope Leo XIV critiques Argentine austerity measures
articles.title: Pope delivers veiled rebuke of Milei's austerity measures
articles.summary: Pope Leo XIV delivered a pointed critique of President Javier Milei's austerity measures during a visit to Buenos Aires, arguing that economies must benefit the poor. The Argentine leader defended his libertarian policies in response, while discussing democracy and public spending during the second stop of the Pope's Latin American tour.
articles.description: Pope Leo made the comments as he arrived in Argentina on the second leg of his Latin America tour.

articles.headline: Turkiye places electrification at center of climate agenda
articles.title: Turkiye pushes electrification top of climate agenda as COP31 set to open
articles.summary: Turkiye launched the 35-by-35 Global Electrification Pledge as the COP31 climate conference opened in Antalya on Monday. Environment Minister Murat Kurum stated the initiative aims to make electricity account for thirty-five percent of global energy demand by 2035, though climate advocates criticized the non-binding pledge for lacking low-carbon requirements.
articles.description: Ankara aims to make electricity account for 35 percent of global energy demand by 2035.

articles.headline: Donald Trump clarifies Dana White press secretary comments
articles.title: A joke or test? Why Trump floated UFC’s Dana White as his press secretary
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump stated he was only joking after posting on Truth Social that Ultimate Fighting Championship Chief Executive Officer Dana White had been offered the role of White House press secretary. White acknowledged plans to meet Trump in Washington, DC, while dismissing prospects of joining the administration.
articles.description: White is a close friend of Trump and has endorsed him for president, but has never held a government position.

articles.headline: Ukraine says Russia intensifies strikes ahead of diplomatic peace talks
articles.title: Ukraine says Russia ramps up strikes to pressure Kyiv at talks
articles.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that Russia launched 172 drones and 36 ballistic missiles on November 7, 2026, causing widespread power outages across five regions. The Energy Ministry reported severe transmission disruptions in Kyiv. Mr. Zelenskyy alleged Moscow aims to exert pressure ahead of U.S.-brokered trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi on November 10 and 11, while the Russian Defence Ministry confirmed strikes on military and energy infrastructure.
articles.description: Ukraine's Energy Ministry said "a massive attack on a number of energy facilities" had plunged five regions into darkness and significantly hampered electricity transmission in Kyiv and surrounding region

articles.headline: Yemeni Houthis launch drone and missile attacks targeting Saudi sites
articles.title: Saudi oil sites, troops and Riyadh airport targeted: Houthis
articles.summary: Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi movement carried out six military operations on November 7, 2026, targeting Saudi troops and infrastructure. According to military spokesperson Yahya Saree, the strikes hit Aramco oil facilities, Riyadh airport, and military installations on both sides of the border amid an ongoing conflict involving a Saudi-led coalition.
articles.description: The Iran-backed group, which is fighting a Saudi-led coalition backing Yemen's government, allegedly launched six operations

articles.headline: Indian rupee appreciates against US dollar in early trading session
articles.title: Rupee rises 24 paise to 93.74 against U.S. dollar in early trade
articles.summary: The Indian rupee appreciated 24 paise to reach 93.74 against the United States dollar during early trade on November 9, 2026. According to forex traders, the currency gained support from lower crude oil prices, improving foreign institutional investments, and potential de-escalation in West Asia. Brent crude traded near $98 per barrel following remarks by US President Donald Trump regarding potential diplomatic progress.
articles.description: Forex traders said the overall outlook for the rupee remains positive as any progress towards peace in the West Asia reduces the risk premium in crude oil and provides further support to the rupee

articles.headline: Election Commission reinstates oversight mechanism for IT head Dr. Seema Khanna
articles.title: What is the controversy over the oversight of ECI’s Director-General of IT? Explained
articles.summary: The Election Commission of India reintroduced an oversight mechanism on October 4 for information technology head Dr. Seema Khanna, requiring her files to route through Senior Deputy Election Commissioner Pawan Kumar Sharma. Previously, a July 28 order allowed direct file submission. The change followed letters from Election Commissioners S.S. Sandhu and Vivek Joshi to Cabinet Secretary T.V. Somanathan.
articles.description: As per the current order, dated October 4, Ms. Khanna is required to route the files related to IT/ICT and Grievances/PGRS through Senior Deputy Election Commissioner Pawan Kumar Sharma, bringing back the oversight which the July 28 order had sought to remove

articles.headline: Stock markets decline in early trade due to IT losses and profit-taking
articles.title: Stock markets decline in early trade dragged by IT firms
articles.summary: Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty fell in early trade on November 9, 2026, driven by selling in technology firms and profit-taking after recent equities rallies. The BSE Sensex dropped 93.95 points to 80,919.19 while the NSE Nifty dipped 30 points to 24,968.80. Enrich Money CEO Ponmudi R noted that investors are weighing gains against potential near-term profit-taking and upcoming economic data.
articles.description: In the 30 Sensex firms, HCL Tech, Infosys, Power Grid, Bharti Airtel, UltraTech Cement and Tata Consultancy Services were among the major laggards

articles.headline: Health officials step up surveillance after Shigella outbreak in Malappuram
articles.title: Health officials step up surveillance as Shigella cases rise in Kerala’s Malappuram
articles.summary: Health authorities intensified surveillance in Malappuram district after eight people tested positive for Shigella infection, including five linked to an October 31 wedding feast in Elamkulam panchayat. Additional cases include a child and restaurant patrons receiving treatment at the Government District Hospital in Nilambur. Officials urged residents to consume boiled water and properly cooked food while food safety teams collected samples.
articles.description: Five of the eight Shigella cases reported in Malappuram district are linked to a wedding feast at Korakkuthu in Elamkulam panchayat near Perinthalmanna

articles.headline: Food safety regulator seizes thousands of tonnes of non-compliant items
articles.title: FSSAI seizes 3,280 tonne food items, cancels 52 licences in nationwide inspection drive
articles.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India inspected 56,431 food establishments between September 1 and November 5, 2026, seizing 3,280 tonnes of non-compliant products worth ₹82 crore. The nationwide enforcement drive led to the cancellation of 52 licences, suspension of 1,133 licences, and sealing of 314 establishments. The regulator stated the actions aimed to curb adulteration during the festive season.
articles.description: The regulator said it inspected 56,431 food establishments during its nationwide enforcement drive between September 1 and November 5, and seized non-compliant food products, including paneer, ghee, milk and sweets

articles.headline: Israel builds 90km network of military roads across southern Lebanon
articles.title: Israel builds 90km network of military roads across southern Lebanon
articles.description: Israel is building roads and military outposts across southern Lebanon.

articles.headline: World Bank brief highlights extreme poverty decline and high prosperity gap
articles.title: From poverty alleviation to prosperity
articles.summary: According to a World Bank brief, India experienced a significant decline in extreme poverty between 2011 and 2023, with hundreds of millions moving out of poverty. However, the report highlights a high prosperity gap driven by flat real earnings, low-productivity work, and rising youth unemployment, indicating that many individuals require substantial income increases to reach prosperity.
articles.description: India has reduced extreme poverty, but its high prosperity gap shows that millions remain far from a comfortable standard of living; informal work, stagnant wages and limited employment opportunities continue to constrain upward mobility

articles.headline: India targets series-clinching win against New Zealand in third ODI
articles.title: IND vs NZ third ODI: Rohit Sharma in focus as India eyes series-clinching win over New Zealand
articles.summary: India holds a 2-0 lead over an injury-ravaged New Zealand team heading into the third ODI at Seddon Park in Hamilton on November 10, 2026. Skipper Shubman Gill aims to secure the series victory before transitioning to red-ball preparation, while veteran Rohit Sharma faces intense scrutiny over his recent batting form under challenging, seamer-friendly conditions that have troubled both top orders.

articles.headline: Airstrikes in al-Shariya village near Sanaa kill twenty-two people

The violence coincides with an ongoing month-long military offensive launched by the Presidential Leadership Council to reclaim territory.
